headline: AI‑driven services lifted revenue and margins for most majors, but growth rates varied widely.
summary: TCS posted solid top‑line growth (15% YoY) and a 24% operating margin, supported by $3.1 bn AI revenue. HCLTech and LTM showed double‑digit YoY growth, driven by strong AI sales. Coforge delivered the fastest revenue expansion at over 65% YoY, raising its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2% and posted modest top‑line growth, indicating a slower pace.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI‑related revenue jumps and large‑deal wins, boosting margins and deal pipelines.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins ranged from 14.8% at Tech Mahindra to 24% at TCS, reflecting differing pricing power and cost structures.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance, while HCLTech kept a modest outlook and Coforge raised its EBIT margin target.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 66.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Strong AI revenue (>$3 bn) lifted revenue 15% YoY and maintained a 24% operating margin.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Profit fell 25% YoY despite 30% revenue growth, indicating margin pressure.

domain_outlook.note: No company referenced media or broadcasting activities.
No explicit mentions of entertainment or streaming services.
Gaming was not discussed in any report.
